---
title: "Combine_Figs"
output:
  html_document:
    df_print: paged
---
```{r}
FigD=readRDS('D.rds')
FigE=readRDS('E.rds')
FigF=readRDS('F.rds')
FigG=readRDS('G.rds')
FigH=readRDS('H.rds')
```

```{r}
library(patchwork)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r, fig.width=5.2, fig.height=5}
(FigD|FigE|FigF|(FigG/FigH))+plot_layout(widths = c(2.3,1.55,2.2, 0.7))
```
```{r}
ggsave('fig1.pdf', width=5.2, height=5, units = 'in')
```
